item.title: Puerto Rican Chicken and Plantain Dumplings (Sopa De Pollo Con Bolitas de Platano) - Paleo, Whole30, Gluten-Free — The Curious Coconut
item.description: Chicken and dumplings with a Puerto Rican twist: the dumplings are made from green plantains, making them gluten-free, Paleo, and Whole30. The broth is infused with bold flavor from the authentic sofrito, made with garlic, culantro, oregano, red bell pepper, and onion.

item.title: Gluten-Free Cuppa Cuppa Sticka Peach Cobbler (Paleo, AIP, vegan options) — The Curious Coconut
item.description: ‘Cuppa cuppa sticka’ peach cobbler is a classic southern summer dessert, made allergen-friendly and suitable for gluten-free, Paleo, AIP, and vegan diets. You won’t miss the dairy and gluten one bit in this delectable treat.

item.title: My COVID-19 Experience — The Curious Coconut
item.description: On June 11th I began experiencing symptoms of COVID-19, and have been presumed positive based on symptoms. This is a week by week breakdown of my experience, including all the strange symptoms I’ve had, with some still persisting into the 5th week since infection.

item.description: My famous dairy-free, vegan, Paleo, and AIP cheese recipe is now available in a convenient mix through a collaboration with Legit Bread Company! Pre-order now to enjoy truly legit cheese that melts and stretches like the real deal.

item.title: Crispy Roasted Blackened Okra Spears with Lemon Garlic Aioli — The Curious Coconut
item.description: This crispy roasted okra is not slimy and bursting with flavor from the homemade blackening seasoning. The easy lemon garlic aioli elevates it to a new level. Paleo, gluten-free, Whole30, and keto, this is one of my favorite summer side dishes.
